opening.argument: Paid entry is the foundation of the offer: the video promotes BitClub participation through a $99 membership payment and describes a paid pool—“Pool 1 will cost you $500. It will be valued at 3 credits.” It then presents credits, team expansion, and strategically placed accounts as a route to passive earnings. The structure is expressly “binary,” invites viewers to “include other club members,” and claims that several accounts can multiply earnings. Salaries, bonuses, branching payouts, and a cycle-bonus figure of up to $2,000 daily for each account are presented as benefits of that arrangement. The mining premise is illustrated with hardware and a Bitcoin-branded pool card, but the material does not independently verify mining activity, actual payouts, participant losses, or whether the illustrated earnings were achieved.
